title: Smart Talk: Cannabis Awareness and Prevention Curriculum Evaluation
official: Evaluation of the Smart Talk: Cannabis Awareness and Prevention Curriculum
summary: The Stanford REACH Lab's SMART TALK: Cannabis Awareness and Prevention Toolkit is a free, online educational resource to be used by educators to increase knowledge and awareness of cannabis and reduce use among youth. The aim of this study is to investigate the extent to which the curriculum changes middle and high school students' intentions to use and actual use of cannabis.
